description: Novee is the first continuous offensive AI penetration testing platform engineered to mimic a real attacker – autonomously, and at scale. It combines the continuous coverage of scanners with the depth of real penetration testing – chaining vulnerabilities, reasoning about business logic, and validating only what's actually exploitable.

Cloud security has long prioritized detection. It has never had an architecture layer that makes insecure states structurally impossible. As AI-augmented attackers operate at machine speed and every engineering team adopts AI services that existing controls were never designed to govern, that gap has become one of the most consequential and under addressed exposures in cloud security today.

As enterprise environments grow more complex, identity governance has outgrown legacy tools. The bottleneck has shifted from having the data to being able to act on it. Opti turns identity governance from a periodic, manual process into a continuous operation across all access types, including human, non-human, and agentic identities. Purpose-built AI models power risk remediation, access administration, and automated user access reviews. Teams define governance policies in plain English, and Opti translates them into live actionable logic that adapts as the environment changes. It deploys in hours, not months, across cloud and on-prem environments. Opti is the exclusive IAM security partner for AWS Security Hub Extended and has been named by Gartner in the emerging identity governance landscape.

Stop secret-based incidents before they happen. Hush Security gives teams runtime visibility and detection into actual agent, workload, and secret risks, then drives systematic remediation and prevention, shifting your organization from secret-based to just-in-time, scoped, and audited identity-based access.
sectors: IAM Platform for the Agentic and NHI Era

description: MIND is the first-ever data security platform that puts data loss prevention (DLP) and insider risk management (IRM) programs on autopilot to autonomously discover, detect and prevent sensitive leaks across GenAI and SaaS apps, Agentic AI, endpoints, on-prem file shares and emails.

Miggo Security, leader in AI Runtime Security and ADR, delivers exploit mitigation for AI and modern applications. While attackers weaponize vulnerabilities at machine speed and patching takes weeks, Miggo closes this Patch Gap in minutes with precision mitigation engineered for the exact exploit path. Powered by patented DeepTracing™, Miggo reverse-engineers each exploit primitive and maps it to live runtime and then generates, validates, and deploys a targeted mitigation on the vulnerable path without interrupting a single engineering sprint.

Minimus, from the team that built Twistlock, is the most efficient defense against the AI-driven security crisis. AI agents like Claude Mythos chain autonomous exploits in hours, not weeks, and any reactive CVE patching playbook is dead. Minimus deliver the only viable answer: minimal, built-from-source images with Zero CVEs at delivery. By redefining how secure software is built, Minimus brings predictability and trust back to the supply chain. Enterprises rely on their hardened container images to simplify compliance, eliminate patching, and ship software that is secured by design.

Autonomous Security is a security layer purpose-built for the agentic era. While traditional EDRs monitor binaries, we monitor AI intent where agents interact with your system. Our platform provides real-time oversight to intercept prompt injections and neutralize malicious or vulnerable MCP servers, skills, and plugins before they compromise the endpoint and run different guardrails on top of everything.

Valence protects organizations from threats created by SaaS and AI sprawl. By unifying SaaS discovery, SSPM, AI security, and ITDR, Valence delivers the comprehensive coverage needed to find and fix SaaS and AI risks.
sectors: Secure SaaS and AI in the Agentic Era

description: Grip Security delivers an AI + SaaS security platform designed for a world where identity, access, and integrations have become the true control plane of the enterprise. As AI + SaaS converge, risk is no longer isolated and instead flows through users, integrations, and automated workflows.

Cycode is the Agentic Development Security Platform that secures AI development from prompt to runtime. By unifying control, context, and autonomy in a single platform, Cycode continuously identifies risk across the AI development lifecycle, governs the AI tools developers use, correlates context across the entire software factory, and deploys agents to address and prevent risk at AI speed.

Orca Security is a global leader in cloud security and one of cybersecurity’s fastest-growing unicorns. Orca enables organizations to make cloud security a strategic advantage. With the most comprehensive coverage and visibility across multi-cloud environments, the agentless-first Orca Platform unites teams to eliminate complexities, vulnerabilities and risks.

Hunters delivers an AI-driven, next-generation SIEM platform built for modern security teams. Its solution offers pre-built, always-on detections across identity, cloud, and endpoint data, with unified ingestion and analysis. Hunters replaces separate tools with a single platform where alerts, investigations, and response are integrated and automated.
Ride Vision brings modern safety intelligence to motorcycles with the first collision avoidance system built specifically for two- and three-wheeled vehicles.

The surge of generative AI introduced a new enterprise attack surface that existing tools could not cover. Aim built the first platform to secure enterprise AI adoption, protecting employee use of public AI, safeguarding private AI systems, and enforcing policies throughout the AI lifecycle.

Data and AI projects require rapid access to information without losing control. Satori developed a data security platform that automatically discovered sensitive data, applied access controls, and enforced policies in real time without forcing schema or workflow changes.

As enterprise attack surfaces grew, vulnerability findings multiplied without context or prioritization. Vulcan Cyber built ExposureOS, a platform that consolidates data across tools and environments, normalizes it, and ranks remediation by actual business risk.

As sensitive data moved rapidly into the cloud, enterprises lacked clear visibility into where it lived and who could access it. Eureka created a Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) platform that automatically discovered and classified cloud data assets, mapped permissions, and surfaced risks across multi-cloud environments.

Identity systems in modern enterprises are fragmented across departments, apps, and cloud platforms, creating hidden risks and policy gaps. Spera Security built an Identity Security Posture Management (ISPM) platform that consolidates identity and access signals from the entire enterprise stack, surfaces risky entitlements, and enables continuous governance at scale.

Application security programs often lacked a system of record, leaving security leaders without a clear view of coverage or gaps. Enso built the first Application Security Posture Management (ASPM) platform, mapping assets, owners and controls to give enterprises continuous visibility into their AppSec posture.

Connected medical devices introduced cybersecurity risks that traditional IT security tools could not manage. Medigate created a platform purpose-built for healthcare, combining device discovery, clinical context and threat prevention to secure hospital networks and patient care systems.

Authorization in cloud applications was often fragmented, custom-built and error-prone. Build Security pioneered an authorization-as-a-service platform based on open policy standards, allowing developers to enforce fine-grained access controls consistently across applications.
Axonius addressed one of cybersecurity’s most overlooked challenges: knowing exactly what assets exist and whether they’re properly secured.

Containers transformed application deployment but introduced unique security challenges. Twistlock established container security with runtime defense, vulnerability management, and compliance controls tailored to modern cloud-native environments.

Investigating alerts consumed scarce analyst time and left threats unresolved. Hexadite built the first Automated Incident Response platform that triaged, investigated and remediated security alerts with speed and consistency.

Enterprises embraced cloud apps but lacked effective ways to govern access, usage and compliance. FireLayers introduced a Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) that enforced security and policy controls for SaaS applications in real time.

Development teams needed scalable performance testing without the constraints of legacy tools. BlazeMeter built a cloud-based testing platform that allowed developers to simulate millions of users and validate application performance in real time.

Digital businesses lacked visibility into how users actually experienced their websites. ClickTale pioneered session replay and behavioral analytics, enabling enterprises to understand customer journeys, friction points and conversion blockers in detail.

Retailers needed dynamic intelligence to compete on pricing in online markets. Upstream Commerce developed an AI-driven pricing and product intelligence platform that monitored competitors and optimized merchandising decisions.

Traditional security solutions struggled to detect advanced, persistent threats in cloud environments. Seculert built a cloud-based threat detection and analytics platform that identified breaches invisible to perimeter defenses.

Web applications were often slowed by performance bottlenecks that degraded user experience. AcceloWeb built a web acceleration platform that optimized dynamic content delivery for speed and efficiency. Its technology improved performance for high-traffic sites worldwide. AcceloWeb was acquired by Limelight Networks in 2011, advancing its content delivery and edge services.

Remediation backlogs left critical exposures unresolved for weeks or months. Opus delivered autonomous remediation for cloud and infrastructure, using AI to evaluate issues in context, assign ownership, and execute fixes with oversight.
